gate.heading: The advanced reading needs an account
gate.lead: This section writes a full reading of your chart -- the timing, the aspects, the harmonics and the strengths -- and keeps every table behind it. It is the most expensive thing the app does, so it is kept for people who have signed in.

header.title: Advanced & Palm Analysis
header.lead: Nakshatra cycles, Dasha timing, Navamsa refinements, divisional charts, planetary yogas, transit overlays, Ashtakavarga scores, Shadbala strength, and palm reading — all in one dedicated space.

transits.description: The current sky is shown against your natal chart, so the active themes stay front and centre.

palm.description: Upload a clear palm photo to bring its patterns together with the context from your birth chart.

dasha.title: Nakshatra and Dasha timing
dasha.description: Unlock lunar mansion analysis, current dasha sequencing, and timing-sensitive drill-downs.

aspects.title: Planetary aspect matrix
aspects.description: See the strongest harmonious and friction-heavy contacts in the natal chart, ranked by orb.

navamsa.title: Navamsa D9 refinement
navamsa.description: Open the D9 layer to evaluate maturity patterns, deeper relationship signatures, and inner promise.

divisional.title: Divisional Varga Charts
divisional.description: Unlock the complete supported divisional atlas for natal foundations, wealth, relationships, career, ancestry, resilience, and more.

transits.title: Live transits
transits.description: Track the current sky against the natal chart to understand active triggers and near-term windows.

ashtakavarga.title: Ashtakavarga scoring
ashtakavarga.description: Unlock the classical Vedic transit strength system showing bindu distribution across all 12 signs.
